title: Goat Sensor Lab samples.csv contract
description: Canonical version-1 CSV contract for raw sensor samples and synchronized live-observer label state.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.description: Contract version.

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Immutable recording-session identifier.

columns.name: animal_id
columns.description: Pseudonymous study identity; keep the farm RFID mapping outside exported research data.

columns.name: species
columns.description: Small-ruminant species.

columns.name: placement
columns.description: Sensor placement or phone test placement.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Sensor source adapter.

columns.name: device_id
columns.description: Phone sensor identity or board/BLE identity.

columns.name: sequence
columns.description: Monotonic per-source sequence used to detect loss or reordering.

columns.name: wall_time_epoch_ms
columns.description: Human-readable Unix epoch time; may jump if the system clock changes.

columns.name: monotonic_time_ns
columns.description: Primary acceleration sample clock for synchronization and intervals.

columns.name: source_uptime_ms
columns.description: Source-native uptime retained for clock-anchor, loss, and replay audits; blank when the source has no separate clock.

columns.name: gyro_monotonic_time_ns
columns.description: Gyroscope sample time when independently available.

columns.name: acc_x_m_s2
columns.description: Raw sensor acceleration converted to SI units, including gravity; no project calibration is implied.

columns.name: acc_y_m_s2
columns.description: Raw sensor acceleration converted to SI units, including gravity; no project calibration is implied.

columns.name: acc_z_m_s2
columns.description: Raw sensor acceleration converted to SI units, including gravity; no project calibration is implied.

columns.name: gyro_x_rad_s
columns.description: Raw angular velocity.

columns.name: gyro_y_rad_s
columns.description: Raw angular velocity.

columns.name: gyro_z_rad_s
columns.description: Raw angular velocity.

columns.name: temperature_c
columns.description: Device/IMU/contact proxy only; not automatically core body temperature.

columns.name: battery_percent
columns.description: Source-reported battery estimate.

columns.name: rssi_dbm
columns.description: BLE received signal strength at the receiver.

columns.name: ingestive_behavior
columns.description: Current live-observer ingestive state copied onto the sample; not adjudicated research ground truth.

columns.name: posture_activity
columns.description: Current live-observer posture/activity state copied onto the sample; not adjudicated research ground truth.

columns.name: welfare_state
columns.description: Current live-observer welfare state; clinical provenance and research consensus are external to this sample row.

columns.name: invalid_data
columns.description: Whether the sensor, mount, visibility, or synchronization was unreliable.

row_rules: All 25 columns are required and must appear in the listed order.
Blank values are permitted only where nullable is true.
Within a session, monotonic_time_ns and sequence must be strictly increasing.
A gyroscope vector is either complete with gyro_monotonic_time_ns or entirely blank.
UNKNOWN behavior is not the same as invalid_data=true.
Use monotonic_time_ns for timing; wall_time_epoch_ms is display/context time only.
